caption: The drawing depicts two wooden bird figures, both positioned upright on a plain, off-white background. Each bird is constructed from multiple separate pieces that mimic the appearance and grain of wood, including oval bodies, flat triangular tails, oval or rounded heads, and rectangular beaks and legs. Both birds have combs and wattles that are indicated with additional carved wood shapes. The figures are colored in various shades of brown, with visible wood grain patterns carefully rendered throughout the surfaces, enhancing the three-dimensional and wooden texture of the objects. The birds stand in profile, facing right, with the upper bird having a slightly larger upright posture, and the lower bird positioned beneath it. There is no additional decoration or detail in the background. The artist's signature appears in small print near the lower right corner.
title: Rooster and Hen
